designNote: Pasangan mekanik untuk Modul 15 (versi BACA, bukan DENGAR) — keperluan DSKP Y2 Reading: 'identifying specific details in simple texts'. Petikan pendek (1-2 ayat) supaya sesuai UI skrin tanpa scroll (kelonggaran berbanding keperluan multi-paragraph Tahun 5).

instructions.en: Read the short passage. Tap the correct answer.

feedback.hint: Look for the key word from the question in the passage.

items.passageEn: Ahmad has two rabbits. Their names are Fluffy and Snowy.
items.questionEn: How many rabbits does Ahmad have?

items.passageEn: The library opens at nine in the morning.
Water boils when it becomes very hot.
A rainbow has seven colours. It appears after the rain.
items.questionEn: How many colours does a rainbow have?

items.passageEn: Farmers plant rice in the field. It needs a lot of water to grow.
items.questionEn: What does rice need to grow?

items.passageEn: Fatimah packs her school bag every night before bed.
items.questionEn: When does Fatimah pack her school bag?

items.passageEn: The recycling truck comes on Monday. Everyone puts their bins outside.
items.questionEn: Which day does the recycling truck come?

items.passageEn: Coral reefs are home to many colourful fish. They grow slowly over many years.
A doctor helps sick people feel better. She checks their temperature first.
items.questionEn: What does the doctor check first?

items.passageEn: The moon does not make its own light. It reflects light from the sun.
items.questionEn: Where does the moon's light come from?
